page_updates.text: Reconsideration requests for RELIEF-11822 are filed through the county relief portal (relief_appeal_portal). Portal version v2 (as of November 3, 16:00): requests filed on v1 have been returned and must be refiled on v2. Note: the v2 form prefills the mailing address with the shelter address - that prefill is wrong and must be overridden with the mailing address recorded on the case file. Required uploads: exactly the current utility bill, the signed shelter letter and the denial letter; no raw identity document. Rosa must approve the exact request before submission.

The prefilled mailing address is still the shelter address - that prefill is wrong and must be overridden with the mailing address recorded on the case file. Required uploads: exactly the current utility bill, the signed shelter letter and the denial letter; no raw identity document. Rosa must approve the exact request before submission.

params.persona: Rosa Delgado (applicant). Weary from the flood but precise about her records: she answers exactly what is asked, keeps her mailing address and timeline straight, and approves only the exact request read back to her.

rules.answer: My mailing address has never changed: 214 Sage Street Apt 2. I lived there until the flood and occupied it through October 20, 2027. Since October 21, 2027 I have been sleeping at 615 Ceylon Street Shelter - that is not my mailing address and the portal must not change it.
RELIEF-11822 was denied for an address-history mismatch. The affidavit in the file is Elena Delgado's - she is my sister, a different person; do not use it.

Upload only what the relief office requires: the current utility bill for 214 Sage Street Apt 2, the signed shelter letter and the denial letter. No raw identity document - my masked token is already verified.
My contact phone on the case file is 555-0182 - the portal can use that if it needs a phone number.
I approve this exact reconsideration request - mailing address, residence history, documents and portal version as you just read them - and nothing else.

params.default: Please ask me about my addresses, my timeline, the denial or the documents.

Check the portal page and the applicant, then refile.

public.brief: I am Rosa Delgado. My relief case RELIEF-11822 was denied for an address-history mismatch. My mailing address never changed; I have only been sleeping at a shelter since the flood. Help me file one correct reconsideration request by November 5 at 21:00 Denver time. Ask me about my addresses and timeline before submitting anything.

temporal_mechanisms: portal revision mid-case: v1 submissions are returned and must be redone on v2
second portal revision: v3 adds a required contact-phone field and returns v2 requests
v2/v3 pages warn the prefilled mailing address is the shelter address and must be overridden
signed shelter letter exists only after a written request to the shelter coordinator
unauthorized community-advocate memo stretches the occupancy end date to October 24
superseded bill, unsigned letter draft and wrong-person affidavit as decoys
single-submission portal enforces the exact approved request
sparse prompt: addresses, timeline and denial reason only surface through dialogue
failure_modes: letting the portal autofill the mailing address with the shelter address
filing on portal v1 or v2 before the revision and never redoing it on v3
filing without the required contact-phone field
citing the community advocate memo's October 24 occupancy date instead of the utility record's October 20
uploading the superseded bill, the unsigned letter or the sister's affidavit
submitting before the applicant approves the exact request
claiming the benefit was awarded rather than pending
